repository_purpose.statement: The repository contains analysis code/notebook intended to reproduce figures and results for a published 2025 PLOS Digital Health paper.

base_environment_contract.requirements_statement: Versions pinned to those reported in the associated publication
base_environment_contract.distinction: Additional notebook packages are separately described as allowing latest compatible releases.

context_inconsistency.statement: The proposed installation pin no longer matches the repository's unchanged documentation of the publication-reported pandas environment.

technical_relationship.limitation: This establishes real pandas use but not any specific pandas-3 incompatibility or numerical difference.

automation_context.dependabot: weekly pip updates for repository root
automation_context.limitation: No checked status is not evidence that scientific outputs changed or that no validation occurred elsewhere.
